            valuesToSet["data.wizard.housing"] = "Corporate Conapt";

            valuesToSet["data.wizard.rent"] = "1000 eb";
            valuesToSet["data.wizard.lifestyle"] = "Kibble (100 eb)";
          }

          api.setValues(valuesToSet);
        }

      // Helper function to roll 1d10 - 7 (minimum 0)
      function rollForCount() {
        return Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1 - 7);
      }

      // Handle Friends, Enemies, and Tragic Love Affairs with proper count logic
      function handleVariableCountFields() {
        // Roll for number of friends
        const friendCount = rollForCount();

        // Roll for number of enemies
        const enemyCount = rollForCount();

        // Roll for number of tragic love affairs
        const tragicAffairCount = rollForCount();

        // Set friend fields based on count
        for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
          if (i <= friendCount) {
            rollOnTable("Lifepath - Friends", 0, (result) => {
              valuesToSet[`data.wizard.friend${i}`] = result.text;
            });
          } else {
            valuesToSet[`data.wizard.friend${i}`] = "";
          }
        }

        // Set enemy fields based on count
        for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
          if (i <= enemyCount) {
            rollOnTable("Lifepath - Enemies", 0, (result) => {
              valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemy${i}`] = result.text;
            });
            rollOnTable("Lifepath - Enemy Causes", 0, (result) => {
              valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemyCause${i}`] = result.text;
            });
            rollOnTable("Lifepath - Enemy Threats", 0, (result) => {
              valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemyThreat${i}`] = result.text;
            });
            rollOnTable("Lifepath - Enemy Outcomes", 0, (result) => {

            });
          } else {
            valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemy${i}`] = "";
            valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemyCause${i}`] = "";
            valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemyThreat${i}`] = "";
            valuesToSet[`data.wizard.enemyOutcome${i}`] = "";
          }
        }

        // Set tragic affair fields based on count
        for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
          if (i <= tragicAffairCount) {
            rollOnTable("Lifepath - Tragic Love Affairs", 0, (result) => {
              valuesToSet[`data.wizard.tragicAffair${i}`] = result.text;
            });
          } else {
            valuesToSet[`data.wizard.tragicAffair${i}`] = "";
          }
        }
      }

      // Process each regular field
      const friendFields = ["friend1", "friend2", "friend3"];
      const enemyFields = [
        "enemy1",
        "enemy2",
        "enemy3",
        "enemyCause1",
        "enemyCause2",
        "enemyCause3",
        "enemyThreat1",
        "enemyThreat2",
        "enemyThreat3",
        "enemyOutcome1",
        "enemyOutcome2",
        "enemyOutcome3",
      ];
      const tragicAffairFields = [
        "tragicAffair1",
        "tragicAffair2",
        "tragicAffair3",
      ];
      const variableCountFields = [
        ...friendFields,
        ...enemyFields,
        ...tragicAffairFields,
      ];

      fieldNames.forEach((fieldName) => {
        const fieldConfig = tableByField[fieldName];

        // Skip variable count fields - they'll be handled separately
        if (variableCountFields.includes(fieldName)) {
          return; // Skip this iteration
        }

        rollOnTable(fieldConfig.table, fieldConfig.column, (result) => {
          valuesToSet[`data.wizard.${fieldName}`] = result.text;
          checkComplete();
        });
      });

      // Handle the variable count fields
      handleVariableCountFields();

      // Account for the variable count fields in completion tracking
      const variableCountFieldsCompleted = variableCountFields.length;
      completedFields += variableCountFieldsCompleted;

      // Process role-specific lifepath
      const selectedRole = currentRecord.data?.wizard?.role || "solo";
      const roleTables = roleSpecificTables[selectedRole];

      if (roleTables && roleTables.length > 0) {
        let roleResults = [];
        let choiceResults = []; // Store raw choice results for conditionals
        let completedRoleTables = 0;

        function processConditionals() {
          // Process all conditional tables after basic processing is done
          const conditionalTables = roleTables.filter(
            (t) => t.type === "conditional"
          );

          // If there are no conditionals, we're done - call checkComplete
          if (conditionalTables.length === 0) {
            valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = roleResults
              .filter((r) => r && r.trim() !== "")
              .join("\n\n");
            checkComplete();
            return;
          }

          roleTables.forEach((tableConfig, index) => {
            if (tableConfig.type === "conditional") {
              const dependencyIndex = tableConfig.dependsOn;
              const dependencyChoice = choiceResults[dependencyIndex];
              const condition = tableConfig.conditions[dependencyChoice];

              if (condition && condition.table) {
                // Roll on a table
                rollOnTable(condition.table, condition.column, (result) => {
                  const formattedResult = `${tableConfig.title}\n${result.text}`;
                  roleResults[index] = formattedResult;
                  completedRoleTables++;

                  if (completedRoleTables >= roleTables.length) {
                    valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] =
                      roleResults
                        .filter((r) => r && r.trim() !== "")
                        .join("\n\n");
                    checkComplete();
                  }
                });
              } else if (condition && condition.type === "choice") {
                // Make a random choice
                const randomChoice =
                  condition.choices[
                    Math.floor(Math.random() * condition.choices.length)
                  ];
                const formattedResult = `${tableConfig.title}\n${randomChoice}`;
                roleResults[index] = formattedResult;
                completedRoleTables++;

                if (completedRoleTables >= roleTables.length) {
                  valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = roleResults
                    .filter((r) => r && r.trim() !== "")
                    .join("\n\n");
                  checkComplete();
                }
              } else if (condition) {
                // Unknown condition type
                roleResults[
                  index
                ] = `${tableConfig.title}\n[Invalid condition for ${dependencyChoice}]`;
                completedRoleTables++;

                if (completedRoleTables >= roleTables.length) {
                  valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = roleResults
                    .filter((r) => r && r.trim() !== "")
                    .join("\n\n");
                  checkComplete();
                }
              } else {
                // No condition matches this choice, skip this conditional
                roleResults[index] = ""; // Empty result for unmatched conditions
                completedRoleTables++;

                if (completedRoleTables >= roleTables.length) {
                  valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = roleResults
                    .filter((r) => r !== "")
                    .join("\n\n"); // Filter out empty results
                  checkComplete();
                }
              }
            }
          });
        }

        roleTables.forEach((tableConfig, index) => {
          if (tableConfig.type === "choice") {
            // Handle choice-based questions
            const randomChoice =
              tableConfig.choices[
                Math.floor(Math.random() * tableConfig.choices.length)
              ];
            choiceResults[index] = randomChoice; // Store raw choice for conditionals
            const formattedResult = `${tableConfig.title}\n${randomChoice}`;
            roleResults[index] = formattedResult;
            completedRoleTables++;

            // Check if we need to process conditionals
            const nonConditionalCount = roleTables.filter(
              (t) => t.type !== "conditional"
            ).length;
            if (completedRoleTables >= nonConditionalCount) {
              processConditionals();
            } else if (completedRoleTables >= roleTables.length) {
              valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = roleResults
                .filter((r) => r && r.trim() !== "")
                .join("\n\n");
              checkComplete();
            }
          } else if (tableConfig.type === "conditional") {
            // Skip conditionals in first pass - will be processed later
            return;
          } else {
            // Handle table-based questions
            rollOnTable(tableConfig.table, tableConfig.column, (result) => {
              const formattedResult = `${tableConfig.title}\n${result.text}`;
              roleResults[index] = formattedResult;
              completedRoleTables++;

              // Check if we need to process conditionals
              const nonConditionalCount = roleTables.filter(
                (t) => t.type !== "conditional"
              ).length;
              if (completedRoleTables >= nonConditionalCount) {
                processConditionals();
              } else if (completedRoleTables >= roleTables.length) {
                valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = roleResults
                  .filter((r) => r && r.trim() !== "")
                  .join("\n\n");
                checkComplete();
              }
            });
          }
        });
      } else {
        valuesToSet["data.wizard.roleSpecificLifepath"] = "";
        checkComplete();
      }
    }); // Close the api.getRecord callback
  }
</script>

<script>
  function onStepEnd(stepIndex) {
    // This is called when the user goes to the next step.
    // All fields in the wizard are available in the record's 'data.wizard' context.
  }

  function onStep4Load() {
    // Get the creation method and role
    const creationMethod = record.data?.wizard?.creationMethod;
    const role = record.data?.wizard?.role;

    // If we already created the skills for this role/method, don't do it again
    if (record.data?.wizard?.skillsCreated === creationMethod + " " + role) {
      return;
    }

    // If we're in complete mode, show all skills
    if (creationMethod === "complete") {
      createAllSkills(role, creationMethod);
    } else if (
      (creationMethod === "streetrat" || creationMethod === "edgerunner") &&
      role
    ) {
      // Filter skills based on role
      createFilteredSkillsForRole(role, creationMethod);
    }
  }

  function createAllSkills(role, creationMethod) {
    // Same logic as characters-main.html onLoad - show all skills
    const allSkills = getAllSkills();
    const skillStructure = buildSkillStructure(
      allSkills,
      null,
      null,
      "complete"
    );

    let valuesToSet = {
      "data.wizard.skillGroups1": skillStructure.skillGroups1Data,
      "data.wizard.skillGroups2": skillStructure.skillGroups2Data,
      // Mark that we already created the skills so we don't do it again for this role/method
      "data.wizard.skillsCreated": creationMethod + " " + role,
    };

    // Calculate initial skill points for complete package mode
    const skillPointsData = calculateSkillPointsAndErrors(
      valuesToSet,
      "complete"
    );
    valuesToSet = { ...valuesToSet, ...skillPointsData };
    valuesToSet["fields.completePackageInfo.hidden"] = false;
    valuesToSet["fields.completeSkillErrorsContainer.hidden"] =
      (skillPointsData["data.wizard.skillErrors"] || "") === "";
    valuesToSet["fields.streetratInfo.hidden"] = true;
    valuesToSet["fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden"] = true;
    valuesToSet["data.wizard.availableFashionFunds"] = 800;
    valuesToSet["data.wizard.availableFunds"] = 2550;

    api.setValues(valuesToSet);
  }

  function createFilteredSkillsForRole(role, creationMethod) {
    // Get the skills that should be visible for this role
    const roleSkills = getSkillsForRole(role);

    // Create maps for easier lookup
    const skillMap = new Map();
    const subskillMap = new Map();

    roleSkills.forEach((skillArray) => {
      const [skillName, startingValue, parentSkillName] = skillArray;

      if (parentSkillName) {
        // This is a subskill
        if (!subskillMap.has(parentSkillName)) {
          subskillMap.set(parentSkillName, []);
        }
        subskillMap
          .get(parentSkillName)
          .push({ name: skillName, value: startingValue });
      } else {
        // This is a regular skill
        skillMap.set(skillName, startingValue);
      }
    });

    // Get all skills and filter them
    const allSkills = getAllSkills();
    const filteredSkills = filterSkillsForRole(
      allSkills,
      skillMap,
      subskillMap
    );

    // Build the skill structure with filtered skills
    const skillStructure = buildSkillStructure(
      filteredSkills,
      skillMap,
      subskillMap,
      creationMethod
    );

    let valuesToSet = {
      "data.wizard.skillGroups1": skillStructure.skillGroups1Data,
      "data.wizard.skillGroups2": skillStructure.skillGroups2Data,
      // Mark that we already created the skills so we don't do it again for this role/method
      "data.wizard.skillsCreated": creationMethod + " " + role,
    };

    // For edgerunner mode, calculate initial skill points and show the info panel
    if (creationMethod === "edgerunner") {
      const skillPointsData = calculateSkillPointsAndErrors(valuesToSet);
      valuesToSet = { ...valuesToSet, ...skillPointsData };
      valuesToSet["fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden"] = false;
      valuesToSet["fields.skillErrorsContainer.hidden"] =
        (skillPointsData["data.wizard.skillErrors"] || "") === "";
      valuesToSet["fields.streetratInfo.hidden"] = true;
      valuesToSet["fields.completePackageInfo.hidden"] = true;
    } else if (creationMethod === "streetrat") {
      // Show streetrat info, hide others
      valuesToSet["fields.streetratInfo.hidden"] = false;
      valuesToSet["fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden"] = true;
      valuesToSet["fields.completePackageInfo.hidden"] = true;
    } else {
      // Hide all info panels for other modes
      valuesToSet["fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden"] = true;
      valuesToSet["fields.streetratInfo.hidden"] = true;
      valuesToSet["fields.completePackageInfo.hidden"] = true;
    }

    api.setValues(valuesToSet);
  }

  function calculateSkillPointsAndErrors(
    existingValues = {},
    creationMethodOverride = null
  ) {
    const creationMethod =
      creationMethodOverride || record.data?.wizard?.creationMethod;
    if (creationMethod !== "edgerunner" && creationMethod !== "complete")
      return {};

    const SKILL_POINTS = 86;
    const skillGroups1 =
      existingValues["data.wizard.skillGroups1"] ||
      record.data?.wizard?.skillGroups1 ||
      [];
    const skillGroups2 =
      existingValues["data.wizard.skillGroups2"] ||
      record.data?.wizard?.skillGroups2 ||
      [];

    let usedPoints = 0;
    let errors = [];

    // Required default skills that must be at least level 2
    const requiredDefaultSkills = [
      "Athletics",
      "Brawling",
      "Concentration",
      "Conversation",
      "Education",
      "Evasion",
      "First Aid",
      "Human Perception",
      "Perception",
      "Persuasion",
      "Stealth",
    ];

    // Get cultural languages from lifepath
    const lifepathLanguages = record.data?.wizard?.languages
      ? [record.data.wizard.languages]
      : [];

    // Process all skill groups
    [...skillGroups1, ...skillGroups2].forEach((group) => {
      const skills = group.data?.skills || [];
      skills.forEach((skill) => {
        if (!skill.data?.hasSubskills) {
          // Skip empty/blank skills
          if (!skill.name || skill.name.trim() === "") {
            return;
          }

          // Regular skill
          const level = skill.data?.lvl || 0;
          const isTimesTwo = skill.data?.isTimesTwo || false;
          const pointCost = isTimesTwo ? 2 : 1;

          // Check skill level requirements based on creation method
          if (creationMethod === "edgerunner" && level < 2) {
            errors.push(
              `${skill.name} must be at least level 2 (Edgerunner mode)`
            );
          } else if (
            creationMethod === "complete" &&
            requiredDefaultSkills.includes(skill.name) &&
            level < 2
          ) {
            errors.push(`${skill.name} must be at least level 2`);
          }

          // Calculate points used (all levels count towards 86 total)
          usedPoints += level * pointCost;
        } else {
          // Skill with subskills
          const subSkills = skill.data?.subSkills || [];
          subSkills.forEach((subSkill) => {
            // Skip empty/blank subskills
            if (!subSkill.name || subSkill.name.trim() === "") {
              return;
            }

            const level = subSkill.data?.lvl || 0;
            const isTimesTwo = subSkill.data?.isTimesTwo || false;
            const pointCost = isTimesTwo ? 2 : 1;

            // Check if this is a cultural language (don't count first 4 levels)
            let isCulturalLanguage = false;
            if (skill.name === "Language") {
              lifepathLanguages.forEach((lang) => {
                if (subSkill.name && subSkill.name.includes(lang)) {
                  isCulturalLanguage = true;
                }
              });
            }

            // Check subskill level requirements based on creation method
            if (creationMethod === "edgerunner" && level < 2) {
              errors.push(
                `${subSkill.name} must be at least level 2 (Edgerunner mode)`
              );
            } else if (creationMethod === "complete") {
              if (
                skill.name === "Language" &&
                subSkill.name === "Streetslang" &&
                level < 2
              ) {
                errors.push(
                  "Language (Streetslang) must be at least level 2"
                );
              }
              if (
                skill.name === "Local Expert" &&
                subSkill.name === "Your Home" &&
                level < 2
              ) {
                errors.push(
                  "Local Expert (Your Home) must be at least level 2"
                );
              }
            }

            // Calculate points used
            if (isCulturalLanguage) {
              // Don't count first 4 levels for cultural languages
              if (level > 4) {
                usedPoints += (level - 4) * pointCost;
              }
            } else {
              // Count all levels for other subskills (all points count towards 86 total)
              usedPoints += level * pointCost;
            }
          });
        }
      });
    });

    const remainingPoints = SKILL_POINTS - usedPoints;
    const errorString = errors.length > 0 ? errors.join("; ") : "";
    const hasNegativePoints = remainingPoints < 0;
    const hasAllPointsAllocated = remainingPoints === 0 && errorString === "";

    // Update the wizard data
    const valuesToSet = {
      "data.wizard.skillPointsUsed": usedPoints,
      "data.wizard.skillPointsRemaining": remainingPoints,
      "data.wizard.skillErrors": errorString,
    };

    // Add visibility controls for success/error messages
    if (creationMethod === "edgerunner") {
      valuesToSet["fields.edgerunnerNegativePointsContainer.hidden"] =
        !hasNegativePoints;
      valuesToSet["fields.edgerunnerAllPointsAllocatedContainer.hidden"] =
        !hasAllPointsAllocated;
    } else if (creationMethod === "complete") {
      valuesToSet["fields.completeNegativePointsContainer.hidden"] =
        !hasNegativePoints;
      valuesToSet["fields.completeAllPointsAllocatedContainer.hidden"] =
        !hasAllPointsAllocated;
    }

    return valuesToSet;
  }

  function filterSkillsForRole(allSkills, skillMap, subskillMap) {
    return allSkills
      .map((skillGroup) => {
        // Filter skills within each group
        const filteredSkills = skillGroup.skills.filter((skill) => {
          // Check if this skill should be included
          return skillMap.has(skill.name) || subskillMap.has(skill.name);
        });

        return {
          ...skillGroup,
          skills: filteredSkills,
        };
      })
      .filter((skillGroup) => skillGroup.skills.length > 0); // Remove empty groups
  }

  function buildSkillStructure(
    skillGroups,
    skillMap,
    subskillMap,
    creationMethod
  ) {
    const skillGroups1Data = [];
    const skillGroups2Data = [];

    skillGroups.forEach((skillGroup) => {
      const groupData = {
        _id: generateUuid(),
        name: skillGroup.groupName,
        unidentifiedName: skillGroup.groupName,
        recordType: "records",
        identified: true,
        data: {
          skills: skillGroup.skills.map((skill) => {
            // In wizard, we use the stat names directly (emp, luck) not curEmp, curLuck
            const statValue = record.data?.wizard?.[skill.stat] || 0;

            // Determine skill level based on creation method
            let skillLevel = skill.isDefault ? 2 : 0;
            if (
              creationMethod === "streetrat" &&
              skillMap &&
              skillMap.has(skill.name)
            ) {
              skillLevel = skillMap.get(skill.name);
            } else if (creationMethod === "edgerunner") {
              // For edgerunner, ALL skills must be at least 2
              skillLevel = 2;
            } else if (creationMethod === "complete") {
              // For complete package, only isDefault skills start at 2
              skillLevel = skill.isDefault ? 2 : 0;
            }

            const skillData = {
              _id: generateUuid(),
              name: skill.name,
              unidentifiedName: skill.name,
              recordType: "skill",
              identified: true,
              icon: "IconTools",
              data: {
                stat: skill.stat,
                isDefault: skill.isDefault,
                isTimesTwo: skill.isTimesTwo,
                hasSubskills: skill.hasSubskills,
                lvl: !skill.hasSubskills ? skillLevel : undefined,
                base: !skill.hasSubskills ? skillLevel + statValue : undefined,
                subSkills: skill.hasSubskills
                  ? buildSubSkills(
                      skill,
                      skillMap,
                      subskillMap,
                      creationMethod,
                      statValue
                    )
                  : [],
              },
              fields: {
                name: {
                  hidden: !skill.isDefault,
                },
                stat: {
                  hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                },
                base: {
                  hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                },
                lvl: {
                  hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                },
                rollSkill: {
                  hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                },
                namefield: {
                  hidden: skill.isDefault,
                },
                subSkills: {
                  hidden: !skill.hasSubskills,
                },
              },
            };

            return skillData;
          }),
        },
      };

      // Add to the appropriate group array
      if (skillGroup.groupField === "skillGroups1") {
        skillGroups1Data.push(groupData);
      } else if (skillGroup.groupField === "skillGroups2") {
        skillGroups2Data.push(groupData);
      }
    });

    return { skillGroups1Data, skillGroups2Data };
  }

  function buildSubSkills(
    skill,
    skillMap,
    subskillMap,
    creationMethod,
    statValue
  ) {
    if (!skill.hasSubskills) return [];

    const subSkillsToInclude = [];

    // Special handling for Language skills - add lifepath language with 4 levels
    if (skill.name === "Language") {
      // Add lifepath language from step 2
      const language = record.data?.wizard?.languages;
      if (language && language.trim() !== "") {
        subSkillsToInclude.push({
          _id: generateUuid(),
          name: `CHOOSE 1: ${language}`,
          unidentifiedName: `CHOOSE 1: ${language}`,
          data: {
            stat: skill.stat,
            isDefault: false,
            isTimesTwo: skill.isTimesTwo,
            lvl: 4, // 4 levels from lifepath
            base: 4 + statValue,
            hasSubskills: false,
          },
          fields: {
            name: {
              hidden: true, // Hide name, show namefield for editing
            },
            namefield: {
              hidden: false,
            },
          },
        });
      }
    }

    // If we have role-specific subskills, add those too
    if (subskillMap && subskillMap.has(skill.name)) {
      const roleSubskills = subskillMap.get(skill.name);

      // Add role-specific subskills
      roleSubskills.forEach((roleSubskill) => {
        let level = 2; // Default for edgerunner
        if (creationMethod === "streetrat") {
          level = roleSubskill.value;
        }

        subSkillsToInclude.push({
          _id: generateUuid(),
          name: roleSubskill.name,
          unidentifiedName: roleSubskill.name,
          data: {
            stat: skill.stat,
            isDefault: false, // Role subskills are typically not default
            isTimesTwo: skill.isTimesTwo,
            lvl: level,
            base: level + statValue,
            hasSubskills: false,
          },
          fields: {
            name: {
              hidden: false, // Show the name since it's filled
            },
            namefield: {
              hidden: true,
            },
          },
        });
      });
    } else if (skill.name === "Language") {
      // For Language skills, if no role-specific subskills, add the default ones but prioritize lifepath
      skill.subSkills.forEach((subSkill) => {
        // Only add subskills that have names and are either default or explicitly named
        if (
          (!subSkill.name || subSkill.name.trim() === "") &&
          !subSkill.isDefault
        ) {
          return;
        }

        let level = subSkill.isDefault ? 2 : 0;
        if (creationMethod === "edgerunner") {
          level = 2; // Minimum 2 for edgerunner (but only for non-empty skills)
        } else if (creationMethod === "complete") {
          level = subSkill.isDefault ? 2 : 0; // Only defaults for complete package
        }

        subSkillsToInclude.push({

          name: subSkill.name,
          unidentifiedName: subSkill.name,
          data: {

            },
            namefield: {
              hidden: subSkill.isDefault,
            },
          },
        });
      });
    } else {
      // Use original subskills from getAllSkills() for non-Language skills
      skill.subSkills.forEach((subSkill) => {
        // Skip empty/blank subskills
        if (!subSkill.name || subSkill.name.trim() === "") {
          return;
        }

        let level = subSkill.isDefault ? 2 : 0;
        if (creationMethod === "edgerunner") {
          level = 2; // Minimum 2 for edgerunner (but only for non-empty skills)
        } else if (creationMethod === "complete") {
          level = subSkill.isDefault ? 2 : 0; // Only defaults for complete package
        }

        subSkillsToInclude.push({
          _id: generateUuid(),
          name: subSkill.name,
          unidentifiedName: subSkill.name,
          data: {
            stat: skill.stat,
            isDefault: subSkill.isDefault,
            isTimesTwo: skill.isTimesTwo,
            lvl: level,
            base: level + statValue,
            hasSubskills: false,
          },
          fields: {
            name: {
              hidden: !subSkill.isDefault,
            },
            namefield: {
              hidden: subSkill.isDefault,
            },
          },
        });
      });
    }

    // Add a few empty slots for additional subskills
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      subSkillsToInclude.push({
        _id: generateUuid(),
        name: "",
        unidentifiedName: "",
        data: {

    const startingGearCreated = record.data?.wizard?.startingGearCreated;

    if (
      creationMethod === "streetrat" &&
      startingGearCreated !== creationMethod + " " + role
    ) {
      api.setValues({
        "fields.streetRatInfo.hidden": false,
        "fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden": true,
        "fields.completePackageInfo.hidden": true,
        // Mark that we already created the starting gear so we don't do it again for this role/method
        "data.wizard.startingGearCreated": creationMethod + " " + role,
      });
      assignStartingGear();
    } else if (
      creationMethod === "edgerunner" &&
      startingGearCreated !== creationMethod + " " + role
    ) {
      api.setValues({
        "fields.streetRatInfo.hidden": true,
        "fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden": false,
        "fields.completePackageInfo.hidden": true,
        // Mark that we already created the starting gear so we don't do it again for this role/method
        "data.wizard.startingGearCreated": creationMethod + " " + role,
      });
      assignStartingGear();
    } else if (creationMethod === "complete") {
      api.setValues({
        "fields.streetRatInfo.hidden": true,
        "fields.edgerunnerInfo.hidden": true,
        "fields.completePackageInfo.hidden": false,
      });
    }
  }

  function assignStartingGear() {
    const role = record.data?.wizard?.role;

    if (!role) {
      api.showNotification(
        "No role selected. Please complete the previous steps first.",
        "red",
        "Missing Role"
      );
      return;
    }

    const gearList = startingGearByRole[role.toLowerCase()];
    if (!gearList) {
      api.showNotification(
        `No starting gear defined for role: ${role}`,
        "red",
        "Unknown Role"
      );
      return;
    }

    // Process gear list
    processGearList(gearList, 0, []);
  }

  function processGearList(gearList, index, collectedItems) {
    if (index >= gearList.length) {
      // All items processed, set the final list
      api.setValues({
        "data.wizard.items": collectedItems,
      });
      return;
    }

    const gearItem = gearList[index];

    if (gearItem.type === "choice") {
      // Show prompt for choice
      const options = gearItem.options.map((opt, optIndex) => ({
        label: `${opt.name} (${opt.count})`,
        value: optIndex.toString(), // Convert to string
      }));

      api.showPrompt(
        "Choose Gear",
        "Select your starting gear",
        "Choose one of the following options:",
        options,
        null,
        (selection) => {
          if (selection !== null && selection !== undefined) {
            // Convert selection back to option object
            const selectedIndex = parseInt(selection);
            const selectedOption = gearItem.options[selectedIndex];

            addGearToList(selectedOption, collectedItems, (updatedItems) => {
              processGearList(gearList, index + 1, updatedItems);
            });
          } else {
            processGearList(gearList, index + 1, collectedItems);
          }
        },
        "Select",
        "Skip",
        1
      );
    } else {
      // Regular item, add it directly
      addGearToList(gearItem, collectedItems, (updatedItems) => {
        processGearList(gearList, index + 1, updatedItems);
      });
    }
  }

  function addGearToList(gearItem, currentItems, callback) {
    const itemName = gearItem.name;
    const itemCount = gearItem.count || 1;
    const isProgram = gearItem.isProgram || false;

    // Determine record type
    const recordType = "items";

    api.getRecordByTypeAndName(recordType, itemName, (foundItem) => {
      let newItem;

      if (foundItem) {
        // Found the item, use it
        newItem = {
          ...foundItem,
          data: {
            ...foundItem.data,
            count: itemCount,
          },
        };
      } else {
        // Item not found, create placeholder
        newItem = {
          _id: generateUuid(),
          name: itemName,
          recordType: recordType,
          icon: "IconBox",
          data: {
            count: itemCount,
            description:
              "Automatically generated via Character Wizard. No data has been set.",
          },
        };
      }

      // Check if item already exists in the list
      const existingIndex = currentItems.findIndex(
        (item) => item.name === itemName && item.recordType === recordType
      );

      if (existingIndex >= 0) {
        // Item exists, add to count
        currentItems[existingIndex].data.count =
          (currentItems[existingIndex].data.count || 1) + itemCount;
      } else {
        // New item, add to list
        currentItems.push(newItem);
      }

      callback(currentItems);
    });
  }

  function copySkillLevels(
    targetSkillGroups,
    wizardSkillGroups,
    valuesToSet,
    groupFieldName
  ) {
    // Loop through target skill groups
    targetSkillGroups.forEach((targetGroup, groupIndex) => {
      // Find matching wizard group
      const wizardGroup = wizardSkillGroups.find(
        (wg) => wg.name === targetGroup.name
      );
      if (!wizardGroup) {
        return;
      }

      // Loop through skills in target group
      targetGroup.data?.skills?.forEach((targetSkill, skillIndex) => {
        // Find matching wizard skill
        const wizardSkill = wizardGroup.data?.skills?.find(
          (ws) => ws.name === targetSkill.name
        );
        if (!wizardSkill) {
          return;
        }

        // Copy skill level if it's not a subskill-based skill
        if (
          !targetSkill.data?.hasSubskills &&
          wizardSkill.data?.lvl !== undefined
        ) {
          const skillLevelPath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.lvl`;
          valuesToSet[skillLevelPath] = wizardSkill.data.lvl;

          // Also update base value if it exists
          if (wizardSkill.data?.base !== undefined) {
            const skillBasePath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.base`;
            valuesToSet[skillBasePath] = wizardSkill.data.base;
          }
        }

        // Handle subskills
        if (targetSkill.data?.hasSubskills && wizardSkill.data?.hasSubskills) {
          // First, handle existing subskills by name match
          targetSkill.data?.subSkills?.forEach(
            (targetSubSkill, subSkillIndex) => {
              // Find matching wizard subskill
              const wizardSubSkill = wizardSkill.data?.subSkills?.find(
                (wss) => wss.name === targetSubSkill.name
              );
              if (wizardSubSkill && wizardSubSkill.data?.lvl !== undefined) {
                const subSkillLevelPath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${subSkillIndex}.data.lvl`;
                valuesToSet[subSkillLevelPath] = wizardSubSkill.data.lvl;

                // Also update base value if it exists
                if (wizardSubSkill.data?.base !== undefined) {
                  const subSkillBasePath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${subSkillIndex}.data.base`;
                  valuesToSet[subSkillBasePath] = wizardSubSkill.data.base;
                }
              }
            }
          );

          // Second, handle wizard subskills that don't have matches - add them to empty slots or create new ones
          // First collect all unmatched wizard subskills
          const unmatchedWizardSubSkills =
            wizardSkill.data?.subSkills?.filter((wizardSubSkill) => {
              const alreadyMatched = targetSkill.data?.subSkills?.some(
                (targetSubSkill) => targetSubSkill.name === wizardSubSkill.name
              );
              return (
                !alreadyMatched &&
                wizardSubSkill.name &&
                wizardSubSkill.name.trim() !== ""
              );
            }) || [];

          // Find all available empty slots
          const emptySlots = [];
          targetSkill.data?.subSkills?.forEach((targetSubSkill, index) => {
            if (!targetSubSkill.name || targetSubSkill.name.trim() === "") {
              emptySlots.push(index);
            }
          });

          // Track which slots we've used in this operation
          const usedSlots = new Set();

          // Assign unmatched wizard subskills to available slots
          unmatchedWizardSubSkills.forEach((wizardSubSkill) => {
            let targetIndex;

            // First try to use an empty slot
            const availableEmptySlot = emptySlots.find(
              (slot) => !usedSlots.has(slot)
            );
            if (availableEmptySlot !== undefined) {
              targetIndex = availableEmptySlot;
              usedSlots.add(targetIndex);

              // Set the name and other properties for the empty slot
              const subSkillNamePath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${targetIndex}.name`;
              valuesToSet[subSkillNamePath] = wizardSubSkill.name;

              const subSkillUnidentifiedNamePath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${targetIndex}.unidentifiedName`;
              valuesToSet[subSkillUnidentifiedNamePath] = wizardSubSkill.name;

              if (wizardSubSkill.data?.lvl !== undefined) {
                const subSkillLevelPath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${targetIndex}.data.lvl`;
                valuesToSet[subSkillLevelPath] = wizardSubSkill.data.lvl;
              }

              if (wizardSubSkill.data?.base !== undefined) {
                const subSkillBasePath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${targetIndex}.data.base`;
                valuesToSet[subSkillBasePath] = wizardSubSkill.data.base;
              }
            } else {
              // No empty slot available, create a new one at the end
              targetIndex = targetSkill.data?.subSkills?.length || 0;

              // Make sure we don't conflict with other new slots being created
              while (
                usedSlots.has(targetIndex) ||
                valuesToSet[
                  `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${targetIndex}`
                ]
              ) {
                targetIndex++;
              }
              usedSlots.add(targetIndex);

              // Create the new subskill structure
              const newSubSkill = {
                _id: generateUuid(),
                name: wizardSubSkill.name,
                unidentifiedName: wizardSubSkill.name,
                data: {
                  stat: targetSkill.data?.stat,
                  isDefault: false,
                  isTimesTwo: targetSkill.data?.isTimesTwo || false,
                  lvl: wizardSubSkill.data?.lvl || 0,
                  base: wizardSubSkill.data?.base || 0,
                  hasSubskills: false,
                },
                fields: {
                  name: {
                    hidden: false,
                  },
                  namefield: {
                    hidden: true,
                  },
                },
              };

              // Add the new subskill to the array
              const newSubSkillPath = `data.${groupFieldName}.${groupIndex}.data.skills.${skillIndex}.data.subSkills.${targetIndex}`;
              valuesToSet[newSubSkillPath] = newSubSkill;
            }
          });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function onStepEnd(stepIndex) {
    // Create the main valuesToSet object that will accumulate all changes
    let valuesToSet = {};

    // 1. First, add the role record to the character if one is selected
    const selectedRole = record.data?.wizard?.role;
    if (selectedRole) {
      // Add the role record using the proper API
      api.getRecordByTypeAndName(
        "roles",
        capitalize(selectedRole),
        (roleRecord) => {
          if (roleRecord) {
            continueWithCharacterCreation(roleRecord);
          } else {
            continueWithCharacterCreation(null);
          }
        }
      );
    } else {
      continueWithCharacterCreation(null);
    }

    function continueWithCharacterCreation(roleRecordTodrop) {
      // 2. Copy all lifepath fields from step 2
      const lifepathFields = [
        "culturalOrigins",
        "clothingStyle",
        "languages",
        "valueMost",
        "valuePerson",
        "familyBackground",
        "familyCrisis",
        "friend1",
        "friend2",
        "friend3",
        "tragicAffair1",
        "tragicAffair2",
        "tragicAffair3",
        "personality",
        "hairStyle",
        "feelingsPeople",
        "valuedPossessions",
        "childhoodEnvironment",
        "lifeGoals",
        "housing",
        "rent",
        "lifestyle",
        "enemy1",
        "enemy2",
        "enemy3",
        "enemyCause1",
        "enemyCause2",
        "enemyCause3",
        "enemyThreat1",
        "enemyThreat2",
        "enemyThreat3",
        "enemyOutcome1",
        "enemyOutcome2",
        "enemyOutcome3",
        "roleSpecificLifepath",
      ];

      lifepathFields.forEach((field) => {
        const value = record.data?.wizard?.[field];
        if (value !== undefined) {
          valuesToSet[`data.${field}`] = value;
        }
      });

      // 3. Copy items to inventory
      if (record.data?.wizard?.items) {
        valuesToSet["data.inventory"] = record.data.wizard.items;
      }

      // 4. Set starting cash based on creation method
      const creationMethod = record.data?.wizard?.creationMethod;
      if (creationMethod === "complete") {
        // For complete package, set cash to unspent funds (ignore fashion funds)
        const availableFunds = record.data?.wizard?.availableFunds || 0;
        valuesToSet["data.cash"] = availableFunds;
      } else if (
        creationMethod === "streetrat" ||
        creationMethod === "edgerunner"
      ) {
        // For streetrat and edgerunner, set cash to 500eb
        valuesToSet["data.cash"] = 500;
      }

      // Apply these changes first
      api.setValues(valuesToSet, () => {
        // 5. Now set all stats using setStatsAndSkills (this will update skill bases within the already-set skill groups)
        // We need to get the updated record to work with the new skill groups
        api.getRecord("characters", record._id, (updatedRecord) => {
          let statsValuesToSet = {};

          // Set regular stats
          const stats = [
            "int",
            "ref",
            "dex",
            "tech",
            "cool",
            "will",
            "luck",
            "move",
            "body",
          ];

          stats.forEach((stat) => {
            const value = record.data?.wizard?.[stat];
            if (value !== undefined) {
              setStatsAndSkills(updatedRecord, value, stat, statsValuesToSet);
            }
          });

          // Handle emp and curEmp specially
          const empValue = record.data?.wizard?.emp;
          if (empValue !== undefined) {
            setStatsAndSkills(updatedRecord, empValue, "emp", statsValuesToSet);
            setStatsAndSkills(
              updatedRecord,
              empValue,
              "curEmp",
              statsValuesToSet
            );
          }

          // Handle luck and curLuck specially
          const luckValue = record.data?.wizard?.luck;
          if (luckValue !== undefined) {
            setStatsAndSkills(
              updatedRecord,
              luckValue,
              "curLuck",
              statsValuesToSet
            );
          }

          // Apply the stats changes and set curhp and max
          if (statsValuesToSet["data.hitpoints"]) {
            statsValuesToSet["data.curhp"] = statsValuesToSet["data.hitpoints"];
          }

          if (Object.keys(statsValuesToSet).length > 0) {
            api.setValues(statsValuesToSet, () => {
              // 6. Copy skill levels AFTER stats are set, then cleanup
              copySkillLevelsAndCleanup(roleRecordTodrop);
            });
          } else {
            // No stats to set, just copy skills and cleanup
            copySkillLevelsAndCleanup(roleRecordTodrop);
          }

          function copySkillLevelsAndCleanup(roleRecordTodrop) {
            // Get the record again with updated stats
            api.getRecord("characters", record._id, (finalRecord) => {
              const wizardSkillGroups1 =
                record.data?.wizard?.skillGroups1 || [];
              const wizardSkillGroups2 =
                record.data?.wizard?.skillGroups2 || [];
              const targetSkillGroups1 = finalRecord.data?.skillGroups1 || [];
              const targetSkillGroups2 = finalRecord.data?.skillGroups2 || [];

              let skillValuesToSet = {};

              // Copy skill levels from wizard to main character sheet using specific field paths
              copySkillLevels(
                targetSkillGroups1,
                wizardSkillGroups1,
                skillValuesToSet,
                "skillGroups1"
              );
              copySkillLevels(
                targetSkillGroups2,
                wizardSkillGroups2,
                skillValuesToSet,
                "skillGroups2"
              );

              // Clear the wizard data and set the skill values
              skillValuesToSet["data.wizard"] = {};

              api.setValuesOnRecord(finalRecord, skillValuesToSet, (record) => {
                // Drop the role record
                if (roleRecordTodrop) {
                  api.dropRecord(roleRecordTodrop);
                  // Finally, look for the default abilities, if found, add them to the character
                  // Create a Promise-based approach to handle all ability lookups
                  let abilitiesToAdd = [];
                  const abilityPromises = defaultAbilities.map((ability) => {
                    return new Promise((resolve) => {
                      api.getRecordByTypeAndName(
                        "abilities",
                        ability,
                        (abilityRecord) => {
                          if (abilityRecord) {
                            abilitiesToAdd.push(abilityRecord);
                          }
                          resolve();
                        }
                      );
                    });
                  });

                  // When all abilities have been looked up, set them on the character
                  Promise.all(abilityPromises).then(() => {
                    if (abilitiesToAdd.length > 0) {
                      api.setValues({
                        "data.abilities": abilitiesToAdd,
                      });
                    }
                  });
                }
              });
            });
          }
        });
      });
    } // Close continueWithCharacterCreation function
  }

  function onItemDelete() {
    // Recalculate the available funds based on remaining items
    // Requery the whole record to ensure accuracy
    api.getRecord("characters", record._id, (record) => {
      const items = record.data?.wizard?.items || [];
      const startingFunds = 2550;
      const startingFashionFunds = 800;

      let totalGeneralSpent = 0;
      let totalFashionSpent = 0;

      items.forEach((item) => {
        let itemCost = item.data?.cost || 0;
        // Convert to string if it's a number, then process
        if (typeof itemCost === "string") {
          itemCost = itemCost.replace("eb", "").replace(",", "").trim();
          if (itemCost === "") {
            itemCost = 0;
          }
          itemCost = parseInt(itemCost, 10);
        }

        let unitsPer = 1;
        if (item.data.type === "ammo" && item.data?.rounds) {
          unitsPer = item.data?.rounds;
        }

        const itemCount = item.data?.count || 1;
        const totalItemCost = itemCost * Math.floor(itemCount / unitsPer);

        // Check if this is a fashion item or fashionware
        const isFashion =
          item.data?.type === "fashion" ||
          item.data?.cyberwareInstallSlot === "fashionware";

        if (isFashion) {
          totalFashionSpent += totalItemCost;
        } else {
          totalGeneralSpent += totalItemCost;
        }
      });

      const availableFunds = startingFunds - totalGeneralSpent;
      const availableFashionFunds = startingFashionFunds - totalFashionSpent;

      api.setValues({
        "data.wizard.availableFunds": availableFunds,
        "data.wizard.availableFashionFunds": availableFashionFunds,
      });
    });
  }

  function buyItem() {
    // Requery the whole record to ensure accuracy
    api.getRecord("characters", record._id, (record) => {
      const valuesToSet = {};
      const items = [...(record.data?.wizard?.items || [])];

      const selectedItems = record.data?.wizard?.selectedItems || [];

      if (selectedItems.length === 0) {
        api.showNotification({
          title: "No item selected",
          message: "Please select an item to buy",
          type: "error",
        });
        return;
      }

      let generalFundsRemaining = record.data?.wizard?.availableFunds || 0;
      let fashionFundsRemaining =
        record.data?.wizard?.availableFashionFunds || 0;
      let itemsAdded = false;

      selectedItems.forEach((item) => {
        // Check if they have enough funds
        let itemCost = item.data?.cost || 0;
        // Convert to string if it's a number, then process
        if (typeof itemCost === "string") {
          itemCost = itemCost.replace("eb", "").replace(",", "").trim();
        }
        if (itemCost === "") {
          itemCost = 0;
        }
        itemCost = parseInt(itemCost, 10);

        // If this is a fashion item or fashionware, use the fashion funds
        const isFashion =
          item?.data?.type === "fashion" ||
          item?.data?.cyberwareInstallSlot === "fashionware";

        const availableFunds = isFashion
          ? fashionFundsRemaining
          : generalFundsRemaining;

        if (itemCost > availableFunds) {
          api.showNotification(
            "Unable to purchase " +
              item.name +
              ". You do not have enough " +
              (isFashion ? "fashion" : "general") +
              " funds.",
            "red",
            "Not Enough Funds"
          );
          return;
        }

        // Subtract the item cost from the available funds
        if (isFashion) {
          fashionFundsRemaining -= itemCost;
        } else {
          generalFundsRemaining -= itemCost;
        }

        // Check if the item is already in the list
        const itemIndex = items.findIndex((i) => i._id === item._id);
        let unitsPer = 1;
        if (item.data.type === "ammo" && item.data?.rounds) {
          unitsPer = item.data?.rounds;
        }
        if (itemIndex === -1) {
          // Add the item to the list with count
          const newItem = {
            ...item,
            data: { ...item.data, count: unitsPer },
          };
          items.push(newItem);
        } else {
          // Update the item count
          items[itemIndex].data.count =
            (items[itemIndex].data.count || 1) + unitsPer;
        }

        itemsAdded = true;
      });

      if (itemsAdded) {
        valuesToSet["data.wizard.items"] = items;
        valuesToSet["data.wizard.availableFunds"] = generalFundsRemaining;
        valuesToSet["data.wizard.availableFashionFunds"] =
          fashionFundsRemaining;

        api.setValues(valuesToSet);
      }
    });
  }

  function onChangeGearSelection(value) {
    let totalCost = 0;
    const selectedItems = value || [];
    if (selectedItems) {
      value.forEach((item) => {
        let itemCost = item.data?.cost || 0;
        // Convert to string if it's a number, then process
        if (typeof itemCost === "string") {
          itemCost = itemCost.replace("eb", "").replace(",", "").trim();
        }
        if (itemCost === "") {
          itemCost = 0;
        }
        totalCost += parseInt(itemCost, 10);
      });
    }
    api.setValues({
      "data.wizard.previewItemCost": totalCost,
      // Store the selected items in the wizard data for purhcase later
      "data.wizard.selectedItems": selectedItems,
    });
  }
</script>
